name: ptg4bl
note: Production target on G4beamline through beamkit: a bare tungsten rod (Use_Proton_Target=4) whose length and outer-radius profile are knobs (R_up at local z=-Tlength/2, the Mu2e-upstream end where the protons, travelling along -z, leave the rod; R_mid; R_dn at +z, where they enter; linear between), from the deck branch ptarget-polycone on the operator's fork. Objective: mu- plus pi- per POT crossing the virtual detector Coll_01_DetIn (tree VirtualDetector/Coll_01_DetIn) (the upstream face of COL1, the TS entrance; unique tracks), maximized. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-g4bl-ptarget-design.md. 100k POT per point (20 jobs x 5000 protons, about 42 min per job at 0.5 s per proton); noise 0.00065 = the nominal point's Poisson sigma at 20k POT (0.0014) scaled by 1/sqrt(5). The 20k-POT acceptance rows (ptgnom02, ptgrmid02) stay on leaderboard_bo_ptg4bl.tsv, outside the training set.
